state: A 38-year-old man from a rural East African farming community presents with a 10-week history of progressive, painless, bilateral visual loss and reduced color vision. He also reports bilateral hearing difficulty that has developed over the same period, and burning pain in both feet. He eats a cassava-based diet and has never smoked or drunk alcohol. On examination, Snellen acuity is 6/60 in each eye with a central scotoma bilaterally on Amsler grid testing. Dilated fundus examination shows bilateral temporal optic disc pallor. Serum folate, vitamin B12, RPR, HIV and HTLV-1 testing and serum thiocyanate levels have not been obtained. Optical coherence tomography has not been performed. He has no family history of visual loss.
